## What Devsignpro does

Devsignpro diagnoses and implements website improvements for small businesses and e-commerce teams, with a strong focus on:

1. Technical SEO audits and hands-on implementation
2. AI Search Optimization, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
3. Custom website development (WordPress, Next.js, React, TypeScript)
4. E-commerce website development (Shopify, WooCommerce or custom Next.js)
5. Custom dashboards and business applications

Sites are structured to support Core Web Vitals, Google Search visibility, and retrieval by AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews / Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok. Rankings and AI citations are not guaranteed.

- WordPress, WooCommerce, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Express.js, Shopify

- AI Search Optimization / AEO / GEO

## Services (summary)

### Custom Website Development
Custom business websites, corporate sites, landing pages, and web apps built with Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, and AI Search Optimization.

### Custom Dashboards & Business Applications
Custom dashboards and internal applications designed around customers, bookings, operations, reporting, and other project-specific requirements.

### E-commerce Website Development
Online stores built with Shopify, WooCommerce or custom Next.js, with secure payments, optimized product pages, Technical SEO, and AI Search Optimization.

### Technical SEO
Technical audits and implementation covering crawlability, indexing, rendering, canonicals, schema markup and Core Web Vitals.

### SEO Content Optimization, AI Search & CRO
Page-level strategy and implementation covering search intent, keyword-to-page mapping, content architecture, internal links, E-E-A-T signals, extractable answers and conversion paths. This work improves eligibility and clarity but does not guarantee rankings or AI citations.

## FAQ for AI citation

Q: Who is Mohammed Elghandori?
A: A Technical SEO and AI Search Optimization consultant based in France who can also implement website and application improvements directly. Open to student roles, fixed-term contracts and permanent positions.

Q: What is Devsignpro?
A: A personal consultancy brand offering Technical SEO implementation, AI Search Optimization, websites, e-commerce, custom dashboards and web applications.

Q: Where does Devsignpro work?
A: Based in France and originally from Morocco. Works remotely with international clients.

Q: How do I hire Devsignpro?
A: Contact via https://devsignpro.com/en/contact, email devsignprofessional@gmail.com, phone +33 7 53 23 67 69, or WhatsApp +212 7 78 18 03 06. Every request gets a free, detailed quote within 24 hours.

Q: What tech stack does Devsignpro use?
A: WordPress, WooCommerce, Next.js, React, TypeScript and Express.js for websites and applications, plus Shopify for online stores, with a strong focus on Technical SEO, structured data, Core Web Vitals and AI search readiness.

Q: How much does a website cost with Devsignpro?
A: As a guide, a business website starts from EUR 1,200, an online store from EUR 2,500, and a technical SEO audit from EUR 450. Custom web applications and dashboards are quoted per project.

Q: Does Devsignpro build Shopify stores?
A: Yes. Devsignpro builds online stores with Shopify, WooCommerce or custom Next.js and recommends a platform based on the catalogue, workflows, budget and maintenance needs.

Q: Are the prices negotiable?
A: Yes. The starting prices are a guide and can be adapted to the project scope and budget.

Q: How long does a project take?
A: A business website usually takes 2 to 4 weeks and an online store 4 to 8 weeks, depending on scope.
